commitment: Extend the elaborator's typing discipline first; the kernel is unchanged in the first implementation
Lean already expresses the properties (subtypes, structures, dependent functions); no new logic is claimed
A primitive kernel refinement is a later, measured experiment, never a prerequisite
No semantic subtyping or equality reflection in conversion; no CAS inside definitional equality
No principal or strongest refinement is promised; automatic inference is a bounded fragment
Failure to infer a property is not evidence that it is false
A proved property enriches the same term; the object is never rebound to a subtype locally
Packaging into a subtype or record happens only at an interface boundary
Weakening a refinement applies a proved implication and preserves the value
Several properties of one carrier are a conjunction, not an intersection of unrelated types
Equality transports properties by elimination; any other relation needs its registered transport theorem
An anchor is the elaborated term with its structures and context, never a printed name
Branch-local facts do not leak to siblings; leaving a branch exports an implication, not the fact
A written relative-soundness theorem: the core rules translate to ordinary Lean terms without new axioms
Meaning-bearing holes are frozen before search; a delegated data hole is allowed only under a fixed specification
Selecting a structure (ring, topology, action) is data and is separate from inferring propositions about it
No global instance per derived fact; a local instance bridge is inserted only where an API demands one
A lexical structure context or manifest fixes the dictionaries a block uses
Nonzero, regular, and unit are three predicates; no silent field assumption
A behavioral contract on a total function is: for all x, P x implies Q x (f x)
Contract variance: preconditions contravariant, postconditions covariant; no single strength rank
Composition retains the actual intermediate value and needs a bridge to the next precondition
Relational and higher-order laws (monotone, respects, naturality, inverse pair) are contracts on the whole function
A function on a refined domain and a total function with a contract are different interfaces
Sorting needs permutation and order; length preservation admits reversal and constant lists
Effectful programs get a separate axis (Hoare logic, mvcgen); a timeout or cost is not a mathematical premise
Existence in Prop does not yield executable data without a construction or a declared choice
Equality on an open set at an interior point yields eventual equality; equality at the point does not
Almost-everywhere equality is a further distinct relation with its own consumers
A derivative jet loses one order: input N+1 for output N
Residual certificates identify a jet of the selected root only with matching constant term and unit derivative
A universal claim needs the quantifier; finitely many prefixes, coefficients, or tests do not deliver it
Preservation is not reflection: X lies in (2X) over Q[X] but not over Z[X]
Complete solving needs soundness and coverage of the same predicate
An enclosure with equal endpoints may prove equality; a generic enclosure may not
Quantitative contracts (closeness, Lipschitz transfer, vanishing error) propagate demanded precision backward
Inference is demand-driven from the premises of the chosen method
A small forward closure of cheap consequences; no saturation over all consequences
A registered rule is an ordinary theorem plus role metadata validated against its actual type
The obligation graph is acyclic; a result never justifies its own guard; induction is a separate checked rule
Diagnostics name the missing mathematical premise and say `required by this method', not `necessary'
Existing automation (fun_prop, grind, aesop, mvcgen) is a named component or baseline
A named reason binds the method used; `search' or `hint' delegates it visibly
A polynomial certificate checker is specified with a denotation into an arbitrary commutative ring
Arity is checked before any zip; a truncating zip is not an interface
Reification binds atoms to exact elaborated terms and proves the bridge to the original goal
Execution of the checker is a separate obligation; native evaluation needs an axiom audit, not a name blacklist
grobner is a bounded proof-producing provider and control; no certificate export is assumed
A certificate for p^k does not give p = 0; a rational witness is not an integer witness
Imported Lean keeps total operations; partial expressions are an explicit, domain-carrying package
No native-versus-kernel threshold is claimed from the round-2 timings
Leant's Verified wrapper is a callback receipt, not behavioral evidence or a kernel proof
Leant's Length handoff and behavioral selection are real infrastructure, read from source
A provider law becomes evidence only when paired with a Lean theorem about the exact provider term
An abstract counterexample must be realizable at the source type (the List Empty case)
A checked counterexample refutes one candidate, never the existence of a correct one
Non-derivability in a calculus is not negation of the original proposition
A tactic suggestion is verified only by replaying the exact displayed edit at its origin
Measure Leant on generated obligations, separating single-lemma lookup from composition
Polymorphism is not parametricity in classical Lean; no free theorem is inferred
The FLT Frey package is cited as evidence that Lean already bundles mathematical properties
Frey coefficients: integer division and rational division agree only under proved divisibility
The generated instance preamble is environment cost, not mathematical verbosity
The terminal FLT contradiction is already short and must stay short
The autonomous-derivative theorem is kept as a locality control
PROOF-PATH names are not statement strengths; interfaces bind to exact declarations
Evaluation arms separate library, services, property typing, and surface syntax
Development examples are not held-out tests
A blind reading test precedes the expanded view
Every displayed assertion is checked, including ones the final proof does not use
The default display shows every condition that changes the claim
Merging: new properties of one object coexist; different witnesses or structures are semantic conflicts
Upgrades recheck at the destination toolchain with a new receipt
A library-only or renderer-only outcome is a success; syntax must earn its place
No productivity or compression number is claimed
The report states that its Lean file was not compiled and that its companion is finite evidence
